style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern community planning meeting begins. Speaker immediately points directly to one clear central problem: a broken footbridge shown in a large picture on table, while facing listeners with an open speaking mouth and concise focused gesture. Beside problem picture lie actual loose broken bridge planks as evidence. Other unrelated decorative meeting materials, refreshments and scenic pictures remain closed or set aside untouched. Three listeners promptly turn attention to damaged bridge image, one holds simple repair materials. No long introduction, no irrelevant talk, straight to the concrete issue. A single straight graphite line from speaker's finger to break in picture can emphasize direct focus, no text labels arrows letters or numbers. Natural anatomy two arms five fingers, table and objects grounded. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored pencil ivory paper, no brands logos watermarks.
alt: 會議一開始，發言者立刻指向破損人行橋的照片說明問題，其他裝飾資料仍擱在一旁，大家直接專注在修橋上。
